lines.en: I ride beneath the big fish's belly.

lines.zh: 我的头顶吸住了它的皮。
lines.en: The disc on my head has gripped its hide.
I go exactly as fast as it goes.
I release, then clamp down again.

lines.zh: 水从我的鳃边直直过去。
lines.en: Water rushes straight past my gills.
I advance without beating my tail.
It banked; I swung along with it.

lines.zh: 我换个位置，往它背上去。
lines.en: I shift my grip up toward its back.

lines.zh: 吸得太久，我的头有点酸。
lines.en: Held too long, my head aches.

lines.zh: 我沿着它的侧腹慢慢挪。
lines.en: I creep along its flank.
Reef ahead; it will go around.

lines.zh: 我松开吸盘，自己游两尺。
lines.en: I let go and swim two feet alone.
The current pushes me back onto it.
I am attached again, steady.

lines.zh: 我换到它另一侧的鳍下。
lines.en: I shift to the other side of its fin.

lines.zh: 它一个急停，我差点掉下来。
lines.en: It stops short and I nearly drop off.

lines.zh: 吸盘贴得太紧，皮都皱了。
lines.en: The sucker clamps so hard the skin wrinkles.

lines.zh: 它下潜，我也跟着沉下去。
lines.en: It dives, and I go down with it.

lines.zh: 我挂在它身上，像块补丁。
lines.en: I hang on it like a patch.
It breathes, and I rise and fall with it.
The rim of my disc tickles.
It feeds; I wait for scraps.

lines.zh: 有只小鱼想靠近，我挡着。
lines.en: A small fish approaches; I block it.
The water is warm; I cannot be bothered.
Pressed to its hide, I count its heartbeat.

lines.zh: 吸盘贴着鲨鱼肚子最省力。
lines.en: Riding a shark's belly saves energy.
I loosen one edge to breathe.
It stopped, so I stopped.

lines.zh: 我抬眼看上面有没有吃的。
lines.en: I look up for anything edible.

lines.zh: 它身上有旧吸盘的印子。
lines.en: Old disc marks are worn into its hide.
It rolled; I clamped down fast.
This ride costs me nothing.
You stand there, far smaller than it.
Your skin bears no disc marks.
I look at you from its back.

lines.zh: 你手上有血味，我闻到了。
lines.en: I smell blood on your hands.
Swim closer and I may change hosts.

lines.zh: 我的吸盘会让你吃一惊。
lines.en: My disc would surprise you.
You are staring at my flat head.
I do not hide; it is right beneath me.
I have seen that bucket before.
Step back and I will pretend not to notice.
It hurts; my disc came loose.

lines.zh: 我掉下去，又赶紧吸回来。
lines.en: I fell, then hurriedly reattached.

lines.zh: 这一下打在我的扁头上。
lines.en: That landed on my flat head.
A patch of my skin scraped off.
There is blood in the water, and it is mine.
I keep quiet for fear of falling off.
The rim of my disc went numb.
It moved and carried me away.
I press close and try not to move.
Do not touch me a second time.

lines.zh: 有碎肉漂过来，我松了一下。
lines.en: Scraps drifted by; I loosened my grip.
I do not chase anything far.
What it leaves behind is mine.
Scatter it in the water; I follow the smell.
Disc released, I swim over.
This piece is bigger than crumbs.
Waiting at its mouth is easiest.
Too much blood smell; I hesitate.
I want the piece in your hand.
Come closer and I will attach to you.

lines.zh: 你碰到我，吸盘滑了一下。
lines.en: You knocked me and my disc slipped.
I reattach; nothing lost.
The bump forced water into my gills.
I am not built for knocks; be gentle.
Your hand touched my flat head.
I press back onto it, away from you.
A knock underwater sounds dull.
I slid toward its tail.
Stop pushing; I cannot hold.
I clear the way; go on.
Another of my kind grips the same flank.

lines.zh: 我们肩并肩贴着一块皮。
lines.en: We cling side by side to one hide.
I touch it with the rim of my disc.
It climbed to the higher spot.
The water is warm; neither of us moves.

lines.zh: 我们的吸盘印排成一列。
lines.en: Our disc marks line up in a row.
It let go and drifted off.
I hang here alone again.
Its disc is broader than mine.

lines.zh: 水里有细小的东西在浮。
lines.en: Tiny things float in the water.
I pick up a scrap of meat.

lines.zh: 它掉下去，我吸盘还吸着。
lines.en: It fell; my disc still held.
I cannot grip iron with my mouth.
I press it down with my head.
The bucket is too smooth to grip.
It sank; I cannot follow.
This meat is two bites for me.

lines.zh: 我把东西藏在它影子里。
lines.en: I stash it in its shadow.

lines.zh: 嘴里有东西，我说话含糊。
lines.en: Something in my mouth muffles me.
I spat it out; too rank.

lines.zh: 它皮上有寄生虫，我盯住了。
lines.en: Parasites on its hide; I have spotted them.

lines.zh: 那块伤口的皮翘起来了。
lines.en: The skin at that wound is lifting.
I pick the spot it cannot reach.
Small target, but easy to bite.
Something moves behind its fin.
I release my disc and close in.
That fish is too lively; I pass.
I act only when it flicks its tail.
I have chosen this patch of dead skin.
It is right here; no long swim.

lines.zh: 我沿着它的皮慢慢挪过去。
lines.en: I creep along its hide.
I find the edge and stop.
My disc stays pressed and still.
Do not startle it; it is turning.
The angle is too low; I shift.
Its flick pushed me closer.
I open my mouth to test the distance.
This small patch is enough.
I wait for it to stop completely.
Now I can bite.
I bite off a thin sliver.
It did not notice; I bite again.

lines.zh: 这点口子它根本不在意。
lines.en: It does not even notice this little cut.
I hold on and get dragged along.
When the blood spreads, I let go.
My teeth are made for scraping.
It shuddered and I fell off.
That bite went too deep.
I reattach and pretend nothing happened.
Do not copy me; you cannot grip.
I woke with my head still spinning.

lines.zh: 这里还没有可跟的大鱼。
lines.en: No big fish here to follow yet.
My disc is searching for something to hold.
The water is clear; I see far.
I try gripping a stone.
Too rough; I will wait instead.
A shadow swims this way.
I set myself where it will pass.
A big fish will come this way.
I attach, and so it begins.

lines.zh: 火在水面烧，我的背发烫。
lines.en: Fire burned on the surface and my back went hot.

lines.zh: 我从它身上掉下来，摔在石上。
lines.en: I fell from it onto the stone.
Water will not pass my gills; I panic.
The blast threw off my grip.

lines.zh: 箭擦过我的背，留一道白。
lines.en: An arrow grazed my back and left a white line.

lines.zh: 这股冷让我的吸盘发僵。
lines.en: This chill stiffened my disc.

lines.zh: 我饿得去啃它身上的旧疤。
lines.en: Hungry enough to gnaw its old scars.

lines.zh: 雷顺着水过来，我浑身一紧。
lines.en: Lightning came through the water and clenched me.

lines.zh: 这里什么都没有，我吸不住。
lines.en: There is nothing here to grip.
